E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Beth and Frankie have a shouting match in the village. James tries to bury his past. And does a resident have something to hide?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Vicky hides the truth from her family. Grief finally hits Ste. And with secrets spiralling, lies begin to unravel...

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Manchester, Raf and Kevin serve up a 'healthy' menu featuring chocolate cake, Chantel and Stephen host a backyard party with hot tub fun, and Matthew and Jane dish up Asian cuisine. [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Classic American: Best pals Colleen and Naomi bought Classic American in New York together, but their inexperience is pushing their friendship to the edge. Can Gordon help? (S4 Ep2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Down City: Gordon Ramsay tries to save struggling restaurant Down City in Providence, Rhode Island. But tough-talking owner Abby refuses to take advice from anyone. (S4 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
E4Plus1.uk.description: Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. We're in the doghouse as pets become pests! Plus: phony phone pranks. (S33 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chaos ensues when bad weather rolls in out of nowhere. Jealousy abounds when a romance heats up on board. And there's a tearful breakup. (S10 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart of Darkness: Bart suspects that Ned Flanders has killed his wife when he spies on him through the rear window. (S6 Ep1/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa's Rival: Lisa is jealous of the new smart girl at school (guest star Winona Ryder) and conspires with Bart to wreck her entry to the Dioramarama competition. (S6 Ep2/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Another Simpsons Clip Show: Inspired by the movie The Bridges of Madison County, Marge sits the family down to discuss tales of love. Guest starring Michelle Pfeiffer. (S6 Ep3/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Itchy & Scratchy Land: Bart and Lisa nag Homer into taking them to Itchy and Scratchy Land. But the Itchy and Scratchy robots go on a bloody killing spree... (S6 Ep4/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Golden Child: Peralta helps Santiago navigate her complicated relationship with her brother. Boyle introduces theatre into an undercover mission. (S6 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gintars: Boyle and Peralta investigate Nikolaj's family. Holt and Santiago bring in forensic scientist Dr Yee to help Diaz close a difficult murder case. (S6 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: And One to Grow On: Phil tricks Luke into taking a dance class, but the joke's on him when the white lie indirectly lands him in the slammer. (S5 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Under Pressure: The high school open house puts the parents in a time warp when Claire gets stressed out by all the pressure. Jay teaches Phil how to play truant. (S5 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Three Dinners: Phil and Claire take Haley out to dinner to discuss her future, but Haley manages to turn the tables. (S5 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Ispy: Claire and Phil decide to spy on Luke and Manny when they're hanging out with one of their more questionable friends. (S5 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The PTA Disbands: Bart's over the moon when the teachers go on strike, but Lisa starts to go mad. And then the governors draft in the parents to teach... (S26 Ep21/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Springfield Connection: When Marge becomes a police officer, Homer sees it as an opportunity to flout the law. But unfortunately for him, she's too conscientious... (S6 Ep23/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lemon of Troy: When the Shelbyville kids steal Springfield's lemon tree, it's up to Bart and his friends to get it back, with help from Homer in Flanders' mobile home. (S6 Ep24/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Pump Fiction: A photoshoot goes downhill when Angelica reveals what was found in Jason's shower. And Demy decides to move on from her friendship with Natalie. (S12 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Wihan's getting it from all angles. Tzarina and Lara confront him over a messy beach excursion, and the crew are starting to question his leadership. (S3 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Starstruck, The Piano, You, Rick Stein's Cornwall, Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over USA, This Morning (longest tongue record) and ITV News of a cheese controversy. (S21 Ep1)
